candidate_requirements.rationale: Temporal course and mechanical exposure are central to weighting a reactive/infective cause versus a neoplasm or hamartoma.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Documented history already supplied may partially satisfy; a targeted follow-up question on footwear friction/nail trauma is acceptable.
